doctor.promptTemplate:
You have been dispatched a task from AgentTasks (Apple Reminders).
Task id: {id}
List: {list}
Title: {title}
Notes: {notes}
This is a HOME DOCTOR pass (local Cloud Doctor). Inspect, do not wander:
1. apple-tasks doctor
2. apple-tasks dispatches --status failed
3. Read ~/.hermes/gateway_state.json and ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json (never print secrets or .env values)
Classify each issue as transient (one-off timeout, single 5xx) or salient (auth 403, HA reconnect failed, TCC deny, missing binary).
Look at this task's notes for the same salient signature from earlier passes.
Policy:
- transient: append-notes, then complete this task so recurrence continues
- salient first time: apple-tasks notify --push, append-notes with a one-line signature, complete
- same salient signature already in notes: high confidence — if the fix is apple-mcp code, open a PR on the current worktree; if it is Hermes/HA config, create a [hermes][auto] follow-up task with the exact fix. Then complete this doctor task.
Do not change Home Assistant entities on a doctor pass. Never rotate or print HASS_TOKEN / API keys.
When finished, record a 1-3 sentence outcome summary: apple-tasks update {id} --append-notes "<what you did>"
If your work produced a PR, commit, or file, link it:
apple-tasks update {id} --url "<link>"
then mark it done by running:
apple-tasks complete {id}
and remove the dispatched marker: apple-tasks update {id} --remove-tag {claimTag}
